author: Second Wind
description:
When players can go anywhere on the map and do anything, how can the DM plan for encounters, quests, and tell a story when anything is possible? Elaine Lithgow, a producer at Rowan Rook and Decard, and Jesse Galena discuss how to make the freedom of choice in a sandbox campaign possible without having a to overload yourself with writing a detailed history and current of every place on the map.
